title: Chapter 892
text:
The moment the Spacetime Amber was formed, the energy was isolated. Everyone stopped and surrounded EsGod. Some of them stared at EsGod in the amber with wide eyes.

"Did we succeed?" Sun Hunter knocked on the shell of the amber ball and stared at EsGod, who was motionless inside, with a hint of surprise in his eyes.

Before the battle, the success rate of the operation was not low, but when it was actually completed, many Beyond Grade As found it hard to believe.

EsGod was infamous in the universe and had escaped the encirclement of the Universal Civilizations countless times. Now, he was really captured?

Furthermore, the operation was quite successful.

"The time of an individual imprisoned by the Spacetime Amber will be frozen. His soul will still be conscious, but his body will not be able to move … We did indeed capture him," Han Xiao explained.

"Humph, to think that this guy would have such a day." Milizaus shook his head.

"Eleven people took action. It would be embarrassing if we failed." Manison's expression was very calm, but he also felt a little emotional about losing an old acquaintance.

However, as soon as this emotion appeared, Manison suppressed it. His gaze turned to the Spacetime Amber in Han Xiao's hands, and everyone else also turned to look at this Universal Treasure.

Although everyone was shocked that EsGod was captured, it did not last long. After all, they were all Beyond Grade As, and they did not have the mentality of looking up to EsGod. Instead, they were more interested in the Spacetime Amber.

During this period, due to the rumors of the battle on Planet Lighthouse, the Spacetime Amber had entered the sights of all the Beyond Grade As. No one was not interested in a Universal Treasure that could easily imprison a Beyond Grade A Super. Now that they finally saw the Spacetime Amber in action, everyone had their own thoughts, and it was inevitable that they were envious.

Black Star had the ability to imprison a Beyond Grade A Super, so he was more or less a threat to everyone. This made everyone evaluate him not only from the perspective of combat strength, but Han Xiao's position was special in their eyes.

Sensing everyone's gazes, Han Xiao raised his brows and put away the Spacetime Amber.

"What a good item," Sun Hunter said with emotion. Sun Hunter sighed. "Black Star, your luck is not bad. You actually have two Universal Treasures in your hands."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. He was happy to hear others praise his luck.

After all, only things that didn't exist needed to be emphasized, just like how ordinary people liked to be called "handsome" …

After pausing for a moment, he changed the topic and said, "Now that EsGod is captured, the mission is complete. I will bring EsGod back to the dynasty. Does anyone have any objections?"

Manison shook his head. He was very interested in EsGod's body, but unfortunately, he could not open the Spacetime Amber.

The three from the Arcane Church wanted to say something but stopped. After thinking about it, they did not reject Han Xiao's request. The Arcane Church also wanted to bring EsGod back and imprison him, but the situation was not in their favor. There were seven people from the dynasty present, and they did not have the confidence to snatch EsGod, nor was there a need to do so.

"Since there are no objections, leave it to us." Milizaus nodded. "Black Star, you contributed the most in this mission to capture EsGod. The dynasty will cooperate and publicize your deeds."

"I know." Han Xiao smiled.

EsGod and the Fallen Ark were extremely famous in the universe. They had a notorious reputation as a paradise for villains, causing countless galactic residents to tremble in fear. Now that this guy was captured by the dynasty, it was definitely big news. The dynasty would not let go of this opportunity to publicize their contribution to 'maintaining the peace of the universe', eliminating a scourge that threatened the safety of the galactic residents.

As the promoter of the plan and the person who contributed the most, he would definitely be the focus of the publicity. When this matter was spread out, his reputation would definitely skyrocket, and it would most likely become one of his representative achievements. The influence of this matter would not be lower than the battle of Planet Lighthouse.

With EsGod's identity, he might not be able to obtain any political assets, but he would definitely obtain high Legendary Points.

Of course, compared to the hidden dangers of the World Tree Civilization, these were all trivial matters. Eliminating the hidden dangers was much more important. At the very least, the citizens of the explored universe would not suddenly receive news of the World Tree invasion while squatting at home.

Without the threat of EsGod, the enthusiasm of the various civilizations for this spatial data would definitely decrease. The research team of the Fallen Ark would also not continue to carry out the orders of the previous leader, so the time to connect to the World Tree Civilization's universe would definitely be delayed.

Capturing EsGod at this stage would definitely change the storyline of EsGod completely. However, compared to the sudden change in the situation caused by the World Tree Civilization's early invasion, this was definitely worth it, winning more time for stable development.

In the future, the three Universal Civilizations and the World Tree Civilization would definitely discover each other, and there would definitely be a battle. This was a universal disaster, and Han Xiao had been accumulating strength for this. To him, the later this day, the better.

By the way, EsGod also said that he would meet me again sooner or later.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He had been focused on sealing EsGod earlier and did not think about EsGod's words. Now that he had relaxed, all sorts of guesses appeared in his mind.

EsGod also knew about the existence of the World Tree Civilization, so he should also know that there would definitely be a battle between the two sides. Therefore, what he meant was that the three Universal Civilizations might rely on his strength and release him?

Han Xiao shook his head. Who knew when that would happen? By then, EsGod's consciousness might have already been wiped out by the long imprisonment.

This time, Lotus Swordsman suddenly said coldly, "There's something I need to remind you. When I interfered with EsGod's soul on the mental level earlier, the moment before he was sealed, I sensed an abnormal mental fluctuation."

Han Xiao's expression froze. "What kind of fluctuation?"

"EsGod's mental strength erupted at that moment, and his resistance became many times stronger. It seemed like he wanted to use his mental strength to stimulate his body and break free, but he did not succeed. After that, the Spacetime Amber sealed him, and our psychic powers were also ejected."

"Hmm, got it." Han Xiao pondered for a moment before nodding.

It sounded like EsGod's last attempt to survive, but it failed, so it was quite normal.

They did not argue about the ownership of EsGod and quickly reached a consensus.

They then turned to look at the battlefield and saw that the three Universal Civilizations' fleets were still dealing with the remaining Fallen One battleships, but no one had any intention of helping.

They only had EsGod in their eyes. Now that the main culprit had been eliminated, these small fries were not worth the effort. Han Xiao was still thinking about the dynasty Contribution Points from [Dynasty Battle Campaign: Fallen Ark (Repeatable)], so he sent a portion of his mechanical army to chase after the fleet.

When EsGod was captured, the remaining Fallen Ark fleet gave up resisting. The crew members were all wanted criminals of the various civilizations, so none of them surrendered. Instead, they fled in all directions, being chased down by the three Universal Civilizations' fleets. Not even one in ten thousand managed to escape.

While waiting for the battle to end, Han Xiao secretly opened the interface and looked at the large number of notifications that had popped up.

[Dynasty Battle Campaign: Fallen Ark (Repeatable)] had been calculated as normal. The few 'Face EsGod' missions had all been completed, and just the experience reward alone had reached more than thirty billion. Even with the standard of level 280, he could still level up a few times. Of course, the prerequisite for obtaining so much experience was to destroy EsGod's doppelgangers. In the later stages of his previous life, only a very small number of players had the chance to do so. In his eyes, it was not difficult at all.

The dynasty Contribution Points had also skyrocketed, and he had obtained more than ten thousand points, which was close to the cost of two Ultimate Knowledges.

What a bountiful harvest!

At the same time, a brand new [Character Summon Card — EsGod] had also landed in Han Xiao's hands.

However, EsGod had too many abilities, and the chances of drawing Esper Silence were extremely low. This time, his luck was average. The effect of the Character Summon Card was teleportation, and the limit was ten uses. The ability was actually not bad, but it was a little useless to him. He already had Void Hyperdrive, so the effect was not much different from teleportation.

However, Void Hyperdrive had a cooldown, so it was acceptable to have multiple teleportation abilities. At the very least, the number of uses was quite high.

Han Xiao had invested quite a lot in dealing with EsGod this time. He had used up all the uses of Esper Silence, which was his trump card against Espers. He had also used up one of his Perfect Mechanical Sense cards.

He still had a blank Character Summon Card, so he could copy another Perfect Mechanical Sense, but he did not plan to do so at the moment.

The battle with EsGod on Planet Lighthouse had given him enough fame, and no one would come to provoke him for a long time. Thus, he was not in a hurry to use up the blank Character Summon Card.

The other mission, [Mortal Enemy of the Three Universal Civilizations], was also displayed as' completed '.

Capturing EsGod alive had completed the additional mission requirement. He could draw three of EsGod's abilities, which were far more valuable than a Character Summon Card.

His Molding Talents were basically all drawn this way.

Han Xiao did not end this mission immediately. With such a precious reward, would it not be a waste of an opportunity if he did not go back and touch his godson?

With his black face, it would be a miracle if he could get anything good!

Apart from the mission reward, Han Technician also obtained a large amount of experience from killing enemies. Killing EsGod's doppelgangers also gave him a lot of experience. Furthermore, the doppelgangers were endless, which allowed him to farm a lot of them.

After looking at the interface for a while, the battle between the fleets finally ended.

Han Xiao looked at the Beyond Grade As of the other two civilizations.

"Our cooperation ends here. Thank you for your help."

"You're welcome. If you have time, you can come to my territory and sit down." Manison invited Han Xiao.

"No, I still have to send EsGod back. Let's talk about it another time." Han Xiao declined.

"Next time then."

Manison shook his head, feeling that it was a pity. He then turned around and left.

Sun Hunter took the initiative to exchange numbers with Han Xiao and brought the people of the Arcane Church back to the main ship. Han Xiao brought the captured EsGod back to the dynasty's main ship with Milizaus and the others.

The eleven of them returned to their respective troops, and the three Universal Civilizations' fleets parted ways, leaving in different directions.
